lines.text: Commander, what do we look like to you?
Body stats check. All clear. Ready to deploy.
Don't push yourself too hard! I've got your back all the way.
No matter what you think of us, we'll always be by your side.
Commander, you don't have any orders to give?
I'll be on standby. Feel free to call me anytime.
It's a desolate place, but we should be able to manage.
The accommodation is neither here nor there. It will suffice.
In these vast open spaces, outposts are invaluable.
I will put it to good use, Commander.
Thank you for this, I'm sure I will find it useful.
Thank you for always taking care of me.
We need to fire straight ahead, together!
Enemy aircraft has been shot down.
I'll leave the rest to you...
